title: Dataset annotation record
description: A single screening annotation for one image. Screening reference only; not a diagnosis. Labels are authored by the clinical owner and must appear in the approved label map.

raw_label.description: Raw label value as produced by the source; mapped via the label map.

value.description: Numeric/boolean score for the label (0/1 for binary tasks).

label_present.description: Truthy flag used when a numeric value is not provided.

protocol.description: Identifier of the annotation protocol/version used.
